{{Quote|I must remember to ask you to advise me when placing odupiendo racing bets.|Drikl Lecersen, to Gilad Pellaeon|<ref name="LOTF:R">''[[Legacy of the Force: Revelation]]''</ref>}}
'''Odupiendo-racing''', also spelled '''odupiendo racing''' and '''Odupiendo Racing''', was a type of race where [[Odupiendo/Legends|odupiendos]], [[Bird/Legends|bird]]-like, flightless creatures, raced on a circular track. Barely tolerated by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the sport was a favorite betting sport at [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] locales. One such locale, the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], displayed a live broadcast of odupiendo-racing on a [[Viewscreen/Legends|viewscreen]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].

==Description==
Odupiendo-racing,<ref name="Depth">{{HomeVideoCite|film=2|featurette=Depth Commentary}}</ref> alternatively spelled as both odupiendo racing<ref name="LOTF:R" /> and Odupiendo Racing,<ref name="TIP1" /> was a type of [[Species/Legends|animal]] race where flightless, [[Bird/Legends|bird]]-like creatures known as [[Odupiendo/Legends|odupiendos]] raced against each other on a circular racing track. The fast-moving<ref name="TIP1" /> sport was seen as spectacular.<ref name="TIP1" />

==History==
[[File:Outlander Club.png|thumb|right|350px|Odupiendo-racing broadcasted live at the Outlander Club (pictured).]]
Odupiendo-racing was barely tolerated by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during its reign<ref name="Complete Locations">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> and the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Complete Locations" /> [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] was known for its odupiendo-racing tracks.<ref name="TIP1" /> The sport was also a favorite betting sport at gambling spots, including the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]],<ref name="TIP1" /> a [[Nightclub/Legends|nightclub]] and [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] hall located in the [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District]] of<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|431|Outlander Club}}</ref> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="CSWE" /> One [[Local day/Legends|night]]<ref name="AOTC" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}} to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> a [[Viewscreen/Legends|viewscreen]]<ref name="Complete Locations" /> in the nightclub's gambling alcove<ref name="FF96">{{FactFile|96|OUT 1-2|Outlander Nightclub Patrons}}</ref> played a live broadcast of odupiendo-racing from elsewhere in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="Complete Locations" /> Several clubgoers crowded around the screen to watch the broadcast.<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref>

During a [[Standard week/Legends|weekly]] meeting of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] [[Council of Moffs/Legends|Council of Moffs]]<ref name="LOTF:R" /> in [[41 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Legacy of the Force: Revelation]]'' to [[41 BBY]].</ref> [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Drikl Lecersen]] told [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] to advise him when placing bets on odupiendo-racing, in response to Pellaeon's prediction that one of the council members had heard of potential stemming from the unpleasantness between the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] and the [[Confederation]].<ref name="LOTF:R" />

==Behind the scenes==
Odupiendo-racing first appeared, via viewscreen, in the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']],<ref name="AOTC" /> released on [[May 16]], [[2002]].<ref name="Year">''[[Star Wars Year by Year: A Visual Chronicle]]''</ref> Prior to that date, the sport was first revealed in ''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Illustrated Companion]]'', written by Marcus Hearn and published on [[April 22]], 2002.<ref name="Amazon">{{Amazon|domain=co.uk|url=Star-Wars-Attack-Clones-Illustrated/dp/0091884780|text=Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Illustrated Companion}}</ref> Odupiendo-racing was later first named in Episode II's [[Depth Commentary]], available on [[StarWars.com]] through the DVD-ROM home release of ''Attack of the Clones'',<ref name="Depth" /> on [[November 12]], 2002.<ref name="DVD">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/news/2002/08/news20020801.html|text=Episode II On DVD & VHS}}</ref>

[[File:Tim Veekhoven1.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Tim Veekhoven (pictured) thanked Leland Chee for the allowing odupiendo-racing lore to be expanded.]]
''[[Legacy of the Force: Revelation]]'', a [[2008]] installment in the ''[[Star Wars: Legacy of the Force]]'' book series written by [[Karen Traviss]], introduced the spelling "odupiendo racing."<ref name="LOTF:R" /> Another alternate spelling, "Odupiendo Racing" was used in the first part of the web article series [[Sports in the Star Wars Galaxy|Sports in the ''Star Wars'' Galaxy]], written by [[Tim Veekhoven]] and published on [[March 27]], [[2014]]. In the article's acknowledgements, Veekhoven thanked<ref name="TIP1" /> Keeper of the [[Holocron continuity database]]<ref name="What is">{{SW|url=news/what-is-the-holocron|text=What is the Holocron?}}</ref> [[Leland Chee]] for allowing the expansion of the lore of odupiendo-racing.<ref name="TIP1" />
